single_writer_comment: Wave admission (#829/T8-A0) is the single serialized root turn
single_writer_scope_note: The root/lock/index families the serialized T8-A0 turn is authorized to write. The turn additionally wrote the six package manifests/routers and the owned proof fixtures; those are the issue's own declared mutable scope, not the root lane.

pre_admission.note: State observed at the admission merge parent, i.e. BEFORE the #829 T8-A0 root turn. This is the only state allowed to prove pre-admission readiness; status=ADMITTED is written BY the admission and can never be its own prerequisite.
pre_admission.writer_comment: A cell moves from `exclude` to `members` in its own work unit, as the last commit, once its `[acceptance]` gate passes. That one-line move is the only edit to this file a cell work unit may make. See I0.12 and I2.11.
